svg.text: Planner: the ASP.NET Core API (custom C# orchestration, no separate AI service)
Checks the user's role and the input · turns the objective into the agent's fixed step-by-step plan
Saves both on a new AgentWorkflow row (status pending) · puts the run on a background queue · replies 202 Accepted
A background worker then picks up the run and gives each step of the plan to the agent's part for that step
4. Pick one, or suggest a diversion
Gemini picks from the ranked shortlist
On the shortlist, at most 3 min slower
Google Gemini through one ILanguageModel interface (third-party)
60 s timeout per attempt · at most 2 retries · 190 s per run · no key or no quota → the fixed fallback is used
Shared state: AgentWorkflow row in PostgreSQL (the model's hidden reasoning is never stored)
Each agent saves every step, tool call with its input, check result, error, attempt count and timing as it happens.
Status: pending → pending_approval → approved / rejected / revision_requested → executed, or failed (safe failure, reason recorded)
Human approval step (React): the agent only suggests, it never writes
the API applies the change and records who and when
a new run starts on the same request
Approving re-checks the rules at that moment, e.g. the ambulance is still free and the ward still meets its minimum.
revision: a new run on the same request
